changeSet.author: PuneetGupta
changeSet.sql: create or alter function [dbo].[GetAuditIDFromUID] ( @Uid Uniqueidentifier, @IncludeActionAssetTypeUid bit = 0 ) returns table as return ( With rs as ( select ga.id Auditid FROM reporting.global_audit ga INNER JOIN ( select uid, Object, objectid from dbo.Asset where uid = @Uid union select uid, 'Tag' as Object, id as ObjectID from dbo.Tag where uid = @Uid union select uid, 'IssueType' as Object, id as ObjectID from dbo.IssueType where uid =@Uid union select uid, 'IntersectType' as Object, id as ObjectID from dbo.[IntersectType] IT where uid = @Uid union select uid, 'ResponsibilityType' as Object, id as ObjectID from dbo.ResponsibilityType where uid = @Uid union select uid, 'Report' as Object, id as ObjectID from dbo.[Report] where uid = @Uid union select uid, 'MetricAllocation' as Object, ID as ObjectID from metrics.Allocation where uid = @Uid union select uid, 'Predicate' as Object, id as ObjectID from dbo.[Predicate] where uid =@Uid union select uid, Object, ObjectID from dbo.AssetType where uid = @Uid union select uid, 'Semantic' as Object, id as ObjectID from dbo.Semantic where uid = @Uid ) AD on AD.Object = ga.Object and AD.ObjectID = ga.ObjectID union select ga.id Auditid FROM AssetType ActionAT inner JOIN Asset ActionA on ActionA.AssetTypeID = ActionAT.ID inner join reporting.global_audit ga on ActionA.Object = ga.ActionObject and ActionA.ObjectID = ga.ActionObjectID where ActionAT.Uid = @uid and @IncludeActionAssetTypeUid= 1 ) select Auditid from rs )
